personality_one_liner: A premium, Nat-Geo-style travel guide that respects the ancient history of Rapa Nui with earthy tones, elegant serif typography, and immersive imagery.

spacing.rule: Use editorial, magazine-like rhythms. Generous vertical breathing room. Allow whitespace to guide the reader.

do's: Skip glassmorphism entirely to match the Editorial Mobile LIGHT and natural aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur or glass panels.

screens.name: Paywall
screens.purpose: A premium landing screen that promises value and captures the one-time $2,000 CLP payment via Stripe.

states.error: Message 'Error de conexión. Intenta de nuevo.' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of Moais with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). At the bottom 40%: Oversized serif headline 'Descubre Rapa Nui'. Below it, 3 bullet points of value (Rutas completas, Puntos Vai, Mapas interactivos). Sticky primary CTA 'Desbloquear Guía - $2.000 CLP' at the bottom safe area.

screens.name: HomeMap
screens.purpose: Interactive map of the island with a collapsible bottom sheet containing the list of routes.

states.loading: Map skeleton or spinner over surfaceSecondary.
states.empty: No routes found for the selected filter.
states.error: Failed to load map data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen interactive map (react-native-maps) showing route polylines and Moai/Vai markers. A persistent Bottom Sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) sits over the map. The sheet header has filter pills ('Urbana', 'Rural', 'Todas'). The sheet body contains a vertical list of route cards. Each card has a thumbnail photo, title, distance, and difficulty.

screens.name: RouteDetail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive guide for a specific route, including infographics, description, POIs, and 'Vai' hydration tips.

states.loading: Skeleton layout for hero image and text blocks.
states.error: Failed to load route details. Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top: Hero image with a gradient scrim and the route's title overlaid in serif. Below hero: A clean infographics row (icons + text for distance, time, difficulty). Followed by a generous text description of the route. Section: 'Puntos de Interés' with a list of locations. Section: 'Puntos Vai & Hidratación' with a tinted brandTertiary background card suggesting where to buy native water and hydration tips for the trail. Sticky 'Ver en el Mapa' CTA at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: ALL UI TEXT MUST BE IN SPANISH.
Do NOT use indigo, violet, blue, or purple in any form. Use the provided earthy Rapa Nui palette (terracotta, slate, ivory).
App must not require user accounts. The Stripe payment is a device-based one-time unlock.
Build a realistic Paywall screen with a hardcoded $2,000 CLP payment flow (mock Stripe integration visually, or use real Stripe elements if instructed).
For the map, use react-native-maps. Place custom markers for points of interest (Moai sites, Vai water points).
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the Home map overlay to show the list of routes.
On the RouteDetail screen, dedicate a specific prominent UI section (perhaps a tinted card) for 'Puntos Vai & Hidratación', offering tips and locations to buy native water.
Always apply a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over hero images when placing text on top.
Use Fraunces (or equivalent serif) for major headings to give a premium Nat Geo editorial feel, and Satoshi for body text.
No glassmorphism. This is a matte, editorial-style app. Rely on solid colors, fine borders, and generous spacing.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt. Use hitSlop.
